svg.title: KAL generative-UI architecture with agent, server, and database split apart
svg.desc: The KAL brand bundle authors the catalog ID, the renderer adapter, the KAL agent, the KAL server, and the database. The agent orchestrates and generates surfaces; the KAL server holds business logic and MCP tools with hard-rule gates; the database persists data. The super-app host only registers the catalog and renders surfaces.
svg.text: KAL brand bundle — published by Korean Air
authors catalog, ID, adapter, agent, server, and DB
install: hand catalog + ID to host

g.text: does NOT author anything · only registers + renders
User: "Book a flight to New York"

svg.text: KAL bundle authors all of: thin FE (teal) · agent (coral) · server (purple) · DB (amber). Host (blue) only registers + renders.
